subject: Quick delay update
text:
Hi there,

Just wanted to give you a heads-up that we're a bit behind schedule today. The morning kicked off smoothly enough, but then one of our internal tools decided to throw a wrench into the works right at the worst possible moment. The complication popped up at the last minute, and by the time we realized how deep the problem ran, half the morning had already slipped away.

We've got eyes on it now, and the fix looks straightforward enough, though it's dragging longer than anyone would like. I'd rather let you know the delay than keep the whole thing quiet, especially since you've already been more than patient with us. If anything, this is on us, and we're sorting it out.

I should have a better update by early afternoon, and once we're back on track I'll send along the revised materials so nothing piles up again. Thanks for bearing with us while we clear this little mess. Sorry again for the scramble. I know your service queue is packed, and we do not want to send you anything half-baked when it might just need a second look tomorrow morning after we test again.
